entries.meaningZh: 道森（加拿大育空地区城市）
entries.en: The traveller sent a postcard from Dawson before heading south.
entries.zh: 旅人在南下之前从道森寄出了一张明信片。

entries.en: Sean found a spare key behind the kitchen clock.
entries.zh: 肖恩在厨房的时钟后面找到了一把备用钥匙。

entries.meaningZh: 斯里（用于国名Sri Lanka，即斯里兰卡）
entries.en: Our neighbours brought back tea from Sri Lanka.
entries.zh: 我们的邻居从斯里兰卡带回了茶叶。

entries.en: We stopped in Stirling to visit friends during the journey.
entries.zh: 旅途中，我们在斯特灵停留拜访朋友。

entries.en: The recording setup included two microphones and a small mixer.
entries.zh: 录音设备配置包括两个麦克风和一台小型混音器。

entries.en: The beach cleanup filled twelve bags with discarded plastic.
entries.zh: 海滩清理活动捡了十二袋被丢弃的塑料垃圾。

entries.meaningZh: 组织方面的；组织管理的（英式拼写）
entries.en: The missing invoices revealed serious organisational problems within the charity.
entries.zh: 丢失的发票暴露了这家慈善机构内部严重的组织管理问题。

entries.en: Reid checked the tent poles before packing for the trip.
entries.zh: 里德在收拾行李出行前检查了帐篷杆。

entries.en: The festival announced a lineup of local bands and visiting singers.
entries.zh: 音乐节公布了由本地乐队和外来歌手组成的演出阵容。

entries.en: Cameron lowered the blinds to reduce glare on the screen.
entries.zh: 卡梅伦放下百叶窗，减少屏幕上的反光。

entries.en: Ms Baldwin planted herbs in the unused window boxes.
entries.zh: 鲍德温女士在闲置的窗台花箱里种上了香草。

entries.en: My advisor suggested narrowing the research question before collecting data.
entries.zh: 我的指导教师建议在收集数据前缩小研究问题的范围。

entries.en: Ellen left the pie to cool beside an open window.
entries.zh: 埃伦把派放在开着的窗边晾凉。

entries.en: Ms Franco tested the new microphone before the interview.
entries.zh: 佛朗哥女士在采访前测试了新麦克风。

entries.en: The travel exhibition included photographs taken in Bosnia.
entries.zh: 旅行展览中有在波斯尼亚拍摄的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 非洲人国民大会（南非政党，ANC）
entries.en: Her history essay compared ANC election posters from different years.
entries.zh: 她的历史论文比较了非洲人国民大会不同年份的竞选海报。

entries.en: The clinic called to say the biopsy report was ready.
entries.zh: 诊所打电话说活检报告已经出来了。

entries.en: The medical student prepared a presentation about colitis.
entries.zh: 那名医学生准备了一次关于结肠炎的报告。

entries.en: The recorder ran continuously throughout the three-hour interview.
entries.zh: 录音机在三个小时的采访中一直连续运行。

entries.meaningZh: 脆弱性；易受伤害的状态
entries.en: The storm exposed the vulnerability of homes built near the river.
entries.zh: 风暴暴露了建在河边的房屋容易受损的脆弱性。

entries.en: We were amazed by the detail in the tiny wooden model.
entries.zh: 那个小木模型的精细程度让我们惊讶不已。

entries.meaningZh: 百老汇（此处指纽约剧院区）
entries.en: They saved enough money to see a show on Broadway.
entries.zh: 他们攒够了钱，可以去百老汇看一场演出。

entries.en: The missing folder appeared unexpectedly inside an old suitcase.
entries.zh: 那个丢失的文件夹意外地出现在一只旧手提箱里。

entries.en: The shelter urgently needed blankets after the temperature fell.
entries.zh: 气温下降后，收容所急需毛毯。

entries.en: Past attendance was a useful predictor of who completed the course.
entries.zh: 过去的出勤情况是预测谁能完成课程的一个有用指标。

entries.en: A shopper returned the wallet she found beside the checkout.
entries.zh: 一位购物者交还了自己在收银台旁捡到的钱包。

entries.en: The two teams competed fiercely for a place in the final.
entries.zh: 两支队伍为决赛席位展开了激烈争夺。

entries.en: 'Non,' replied the French visitor, declining another cup of coffee.
entries.zh: 那位法国客人回答“不”，拒绝再来一杯咖啡。

entries.en: The insurer asked for photographs of the damaged roof.
entries.zh: 保险公司要求提供受损屋顶的照片。

entries.en: The child peered curiously into the empty birdhouse.
entries.zh: 孩子好奇地朝空鸟屋里看。

entries.en: The terrified dog hid under the table during the fireworks.
entries.zh: 放烟花时，那只吓坏了的狗躲在桌子下面。

entries.en: The room was appropriately lit for examining the delicate photographs.
entries.zh: 房间的照明恰到好处，适合查看那些易损的照片。

entries.en: Jeremy taped the loose cable to the edge of the desk.
entries.zh: 杰里米用胶带把松散的电缆固定在桌边。

entries.en: Her watercolor of the harbour hung above the dining table.
entries.zh: 她画的港口水彩画挂在餐桌上方。

entries.meaningZh: 城堡外院；城堡围墙内的庭院
entries.en: Visitors crossed the castle bailey before entering the main tower.
entries.zh: 游客穿过城堡外院后进入主塔。

entries.en: Her friends secretly organised a concert for her birthday.
entries.zh: 朋友们秘密为她的生日筹办了一场音乐会。

entries.en: The caregiver wrote down the questions the family wanted to ask.
entries.zh: 照护者记下了家属想要提出的问题。

entries.en: The survey included households from several socioeconomic backgrounds.
entries.zh: 调查涵盖了来自多种社会经济背景的家庭。

entries.en: She proudly displayed the wooden chair she had built herself.
entries.zh: 她自豪地展示了自己亲手制作的木椅。

entries.en: Raymond practised the opening bars slowly with a metronome.
entries.zh: 雷蒙德跟着节拍器慢慢练习了开头几个小节。

entries.en: The filmmaker interviewed residents before writing the documentary script.
entries.zh: 电影制作人在编写纪录片脚本前采访了居民。

entries.meaningZh: 福尔摩斯（此处指虚构侦探夏洛克·福尔摩斯）
entries.en: The book club discussed how Holmes interprets small clues.
entries.zh: 读书会讨论了福尔摩斯如何解读细小的线索。

entries.en: The manuscript was extensively revised after the first round of feedback.
entries.zh: 第一轮反馈后，手稿经过了大幅修改。

entries.en: Leslie measured the curtains twice before ordering the fabric.
entries.zh: 莱斯利量了两遍窗帘尺寸才订购布料。

entries.en: Dr Powell examined the handwritten corrections in the manuscript.
entries.zh: 鲍威尔博士查看了手稿上的手写修改。

entries.en: We hastily covered the picnic food when the rain began.
entries.zh: 开始下雨时，我们匆忙盖住了野餐食物。

entries.en: Her cousins in Sutton invited us to stay for the weekend.
entries.zh: 她在萨顿的表亲邀请我们过去住一个周末。

entries.meaningZh: 印度群岛（此处用于West Indies，即西印度群岛）
entries.en: The old atlas showed shipping routes through the West Indies.
entries.zh: 那本旧地图集标出了穿过西印度群岛的航线。

entries.en: A peaceful protester handed a petition to the council clerk.
entries.zh: 一名和平抗议者把请愿书交给了议会办事员。

entries.en: Adrian put fresh batteries in the torch before sunset.
entries.zh: 阿德里安在日落前给手电筒装上了新电池。

entries.meaningZh: 市电；供电干线（英式用法）
entries.en: The radio runs on batteries or plugs into the mains.
entries.zh: 这台收音机既能用电池，也能接市电。

entries.meaningZh: 自由民（尤用于历史语境）
entries.en: In the historical novel, the former servant becomes a freeman.
entries.zh: 在这本历史小说中，那位曾经的仆人成了自由民。

entries.meaningZh: 咄咄逼人地；带有攻击性地
entries.en: The customer spoke aggressively, but the receptionist remained calm.
entries.zh: 顾客说话咄咄逼人，但接待员仍保持冷静。

entries.en: Rising transport costs reduced the profitability of the small bakery.
entries.zh: 运输成本上涨降低了这家小面包店的盈利能力。

entries.en: In the medieval tale, a palmer asks for shelter at the inn.
entries.zh: 在这个中世纪故事里，一名朝圣者请求在旅店住宿。

entries.meaningZh: 朴茨茅斯（此处指英国港口城市）
entries.en: We caught the evening train back from Portsmouth.
entries.zh: 我们从朴茨茅斯乘晚间火车返回。

entries.en: Ms Robertson sorted the children's drawings into dated folders.
entries.zh: 罗伯逊女士把孩子们的画分装进标有日期的文件夹。

entries.en: Alexandra recorded the bird calls from a sheltered spot beside the lake.
entries.zh: 亚历山德拉在湖边一处有遮蔽的地方录下了鸟鸣。

entries.en: Jackie used a ruler to space the photographs evenly.
entries.zh: 杰基用尺子把照片等距排开。

entries.en: Clear labelling allowed easy differentiation between the two nearly identical samples.
entries.zh: 清晰的标签使那两个几乎相同的样本很容易区分。

entries.en: The letter confirmed her entitlement to paid parental leave.
entries.zh: 信中确认了她享有带薪育儿假的权利。

entries.en: The archaeologist brushed loose soil from a broken clay handle.
entries.zh: 考古学家刷去了破陶把手上的松土。

entries.en: Morton balanced the stack of plates carefully on one arm.
entries.zh: 莫顿小心地用一只手臂托稳那摞盘子。

entries.en: The class compared two poems by Wordsworth.
entries.zh: 全班比较了华兹华斯的两首诗。

entries.en: A pink lotus opened above the still water.
entries.zh: 一朵粉色荷花在平静的水面上绽放。

entries.en: Professor Thomson brought a magnifying glass to examine the old map.
entries.zh: 汤姆森教授带来放大镜查看那张旧地图。

entries.en: Eva kept the seed packets in a dry tin.
entries.zh: 伊娃把种子袋保存在一个干燥的铁盒里。

entries.en: The coach stopped in Blackburn to pick up more passengers.
entries.zh: 长途客车在布莱克本停下，接上更多乘客。

entries.en: Jamie found a small tear in the tent roof.
entries.zh: 杰米发现帐篷顶部有一个小裂口。

entries.en: Agnes rolled the dough into a circle before adding the filling.
entries.zh: 艾格尼丝把面团擀成圆形后才加馅。

entries.en: Mr Coleman labelled each drawer with the names of the tools inside.
entries.zh: 科尔曼先生在每个抽屉上标出了里面工具的名称。

entries.en: Polly discovered that the library stayed open late on Thursdays.
entries.zh: 波莉发现图书馆每周四会开放到很晚。

entries.en: The exhibition included embroidered textiles from Ukraine.
entries.zh: 展览中有来自乌克兰的刺绣织物。

entries.en: Ms Doyle counted the empty seats before starting the workshop.
entries.zh: 道尔女士在工作坊开始前数了数空座位。

entries.en: Nathan adjusted the lamp to illuminate the handwritten notes.
entries.zh: 内森调整台灯，照亮那些手写笔记。

entries.en: Donna tucked a pressed flower between the notebook pages.
entries.zh: 唐娜在笔记本页间夹了一朵压干的花。

entries.en: Nina practised the violin with the practice-room door closed.
entries.zh: 尼娜关着练习室的门练小提琴。

entries.meaningZh: 萨达姆（人名；此处指萨达姆·侯赛因）
entries.en: The history lecture included a photograph of Saddam Hussein.
entries.zh: 历史课展示了一张萨达姆·侯赛因的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 木底套鞋（历史上用于垫高鞋底）
entries.en: The costume display included a wooden patten worn over a shoe.
entries.zh: 服装展陈中有一只套在鞋外的木底套鞋。

entries.en: Miranda noticed the printer had skipped the final page.
entries.zh: 米兰达注意到打印机漏印了最后一页。

entries.meaningZh: 塞尔维亚的；塞尔维亚语的
entries.en: The archive holds a collection of Serbian folk songs.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着一批塞尔维亚民歌。

entries.en: The recipe calls for six oz of grated cheese.
entries.zh: 食谱需要六盎司的奶酪碎。

entries.en: The two designs are visually similar but function quite differently.
entries.zh: 这两种设计看起来相似，功能却很不同。

entries.meaningZh: 安培（电流单位ampere的非正式简称）
entries.en: The circuit diagram specifies a current of one amp.
entries.zh: 电路图规定的电流为一安培。

entries.en: Robbie found the missing chess piece underneath the radiator.
entries.zh: 罗比在暖气片下面找到了丢失的棋子。

entries.en: The exercise asks students to identify the sentence's syntactic structure.
entries.zh: 这道练习要求学生辨认句子的句法结构。

entries.meaningZh: 上诉法院法官（Lord或Lady Justice的头衔缩写）
entries.en: The law student's notes referred to the opinion of Smith LJ.
entries.zh: 那名法学生的笔记提到了史密斯上诉法院法官的意见。

entries.meaningZh: 研究与发展办公室（此处指美国环保署的旧机构）
entries.en: The archive contained a report produced by the EPA's ORD.
entries.zh: 档案中有一份由美国环保署研究与发展办公室编写的报告。

entries.en: The laboratory report included a separate platelet count.
entries.zh: 实验室报告单独列出了血小板计数。

entries.en: She shook the bottle vigorously before pouring the dressing.
entries.zh: 她用力摇了摇瓶子，然后倒出沙拉调味汁。

entries.en: Please send the photographs today, preferably before noon.
entries.zh: 请今天发送照片，最好在中午之前。

entries.meaningZh: 种族主义的；种族歧视的
entries.en: The school investigated a complaint about racist remarks.
entries.zh: 学校调查了一起有关种族歧视言论的投诉。

entries.meaningZh: 北美马鹿（采用美式词义，并非麋鹿）
entries.en: A bull elk stood at the edge of the pine forest.
entries.zh: 一头雄性北美马鹿站在松林边缘。

entries.en: She felt morally obliged to return the money she had found.
entries.zh: 她觉得自己在道德上有义务归还捡到的钱。

entries.en: The extra pair of hands helped enormously during the move.
entries.zh: 搬家时，多一个人帮忙起了很大的作用。

entries.en: Driving through that blizzard would be sheer madness.
entries.zh: 开车穿过那场暴风雪简直是疯狂之举。

entries.en: The storm damaged several farms in the northwestern valley.
entries.zh: 风暴损坏了西北部山谷里的几座农场。

entries.en: The discussion explored spirituality without assuming any particular religious belief.
entries.zh: 讨论探讨了精神生活，并未预设某一种宗教信仰。

entries.en: The software randomly selected ten answers for a second review.
entries.zh: 软件随机选出十份答案进行再次审核。

entries.meaningZh: 普利茅斯（此处指英格兰城市）
entries.en: Our friends in Plymouth offered us a room for the night.
entries.zh: 我们在普利茅斯的朋友给我们提供了一间过夜的房间。

entries.meaningZh: 复滑车；船上用的滑轮吊索装置
entries.en: The sailor inspected the burton before lifting the heavy crate.
entries.zh: 水手在吊起沉重木箱前检查了复滑车装置。

entries.en: Students should examine the source critically before accepting its claims.
entries.zh: 学生应在接受某来源的说法前，批判性地审视它。

entries.en: He politely declined the invitation without giving a detailed explanation.
entries.zh: 他礼貌地谢绝了邀请，没有详细解释原因。

entries.en: The policymaker consulted teachers before proposing changes to the curriculum.
entries.zh: 政策制定者在提议调整课程前征求了教师的意见。

entries.en: The golfer waited for the wind to ease before taking the shot.
entries.zh: 高尔夫球手等风小一些后才击球。

entries.en: The shop window was brightly lit long after sunset.
entries.zh: 日落很久后，商店橱窗仍灯光明亮。

entries.en: They rented a cottage in Dorset for the summer.
entries.zh: 他们在多塞特郡租了一间小屋过夏天。

entries.en: Shirley placed a tray beneath the dripping plant pot.
entries.zh: 雪莉在滴水的花盆下面放了一个托盘。

entries.en: The path grew progressively steeper as we approached the ridge.
entries.zh: 接近山脊时，小路逐渐变得更陡。

entries.en: Dr Andrews recorded the interview in a quiet room upstairs.
entries.zh: 安德鲁斯博士在楼上一间安静的房间录下了采访。

entries.meaningZh: 索尔兹伯里（此处指英格兰城市）
entries.en: We changed our plans and stayed another night in Salisbury.
entries.zh: 我们改变了计划，在索尔兹伯里又住了一晚。

entries.en: Francisco taped the route map beside the front door.
entries.zh: 弗朗西斯科把路线图贴在了前门旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 线卫（美式橄榄球防守位置）
entries.en: The linebacker moved toward the runner as the play developed.
entries.zh: 进攻展开时，线卫朝持球跑动者移动。

entries.meaningZh: 幽谷；狭长山谷（尤指苏格兰或爱尔兰的山谷）
entries.en: A low mist concealed the cottages at the far end of the glen.
entries.zh: 一层低雾遮住了山谷远端的村舍。

entries.en: Mr Simpson replaced the cracked handle on the old suitcase.
entries.zh: 辛普森先生更换了旧手提箱上开裂的把手。

entries.en: The students travelled to Exeter for a weekend debate.
entries.zh: 学生们前往埃克塞特参加周末辩论。

entries.en: The substitution of oat milk changed the cake's texture slightly.
entries.zh: 改用燕麦奶后，蛋糕的口感略有变化。

entries.en: The family spent two days walking through villages in Wiltshire.
entries.zh: 这家人花了两天步行游览威尔特郡的村庄。

entries.en: He hung his wet mac on a hook by the door.
entries.zh: 他把湿雨衣挂在门边的挂钩上。

entries.en: Pierre lifted the lid to check whether the bread had risen.
entries.zh: 皮埃尔揭开盖子，看看面包面团是否已经发起。

entries.en: Karl brushed the sand off his shoes before entering the car.
entries.zh: 卡尔上车前刷掉了鞋上的沙子。

entries.en: The garden design utilises rainwater collected from the shed roof.
entries.zh: 这项花园设计利用了从工具棚屋顶收集的雨水。

entries.meaningZh: 同性恋；对同性的情感或性吸引
entries.en: The exhibition examined changing social attitudes toward homosexuality.
entries.zh: 展览考察了社会对同性恋态度的变化。

entries.en: Ms Jenkins kept a spare pair of gloves in the car.
entries.zh: 詹金斯女士在车里放了一副备用手套。

entries.en: The southeastern corner of the garden receives the most sunlight.
entries.zh: 花园的东南角得到的阳光最多。

entries.en: Edmund checked the concert programme before choosing a seat.
entries.zh: 埃德蒙选座位前查看了音乐会节目单。

entries.en: The members voted for the dissolution of the inactive society.
entries.zh: 成员投票决定解散这个已停止活动的社团。

entries.en: The divisional manager approved the revised training schedule.
entries.zh: 部门经理批准了修改后的培训安排。

entries.en: Jacob folded the large drawing so it would fit inside his bag.
entries.zh: 雅各布把大幅图纸折好，以便装进包里。

entries.en: The diagram appears near the beginning of Chapter VII.
entries.zh: 示意图出现在第七章开头附近。

entries.en: She casually mentioned that she had already completed the difficult course.
entries.zh: 她随口提到自己已经完成了那门难课。

entries.en: Gerry spotted a heron beside the lock gate.
entries.zh: 格里在船闸门旁看见了一只苍鹭。

entries.en: Frederick tested the garden soil before planting the rose bushes.
entries.zh: 弗雷德里克在种玫瑰丛前检测了花园土壤。

entries.meaningZh: 活动倡导者；为某项事业奔走的人
entries.en: The campaigner collected signatures to protect the neighbourhood library.
entries.zh: 那位活动倡导者征集签名，争取保住社区图书馆。

entries.en: The witness described the interrogation in a written statement.
entries.zh: 证人在书面陈述中描述了讯问过程。

entries.en: Bennett compared the broken hinge with the replacement part.
entries.zh: 贝内特把坏铰链和替换零件作了比较。

entries.en: Wayne put a dry towel beside the muddy back door.
entries.zh: 韦恩在沾满泥的后门旁放了一条干毛巾。

entries.en: Evelyn arranged the wildflowers in a narrow glass vase.
entries.zh: 伊夫林把野花插进了一只细长的玻璃花瓶。

entries.meaningZh: 乔（人名，常为Joanna或Josephine等名字的简称）
entries.en: Jo found a quiet table near the back of the cafe.
entries.zh: 乔在咖啡馆后部找到了一张安静的桌子。

entries.en: The fisher untangled the net before the tide turned.
entries.zh: 渔民在潮向改变前解开了缠结的渔网。

entries.en: Maureen saved the interesting article in a folder for later reading.
entries.zh: 莫琳把那篇有趣的文章存进文件夹，准备以后阅读。

entries.en: Alec placed the fragile model inside a padded box.
entries.zh: 亚历克把易碎模型放进了带衬垫的盒子。

entries.en: Julius lowered his voice when the rehearsal began.
entries.zh: 排练开始时，朱利叶斯放低了声音。

entries.en: Wendy spread the damp photographs across a clean towel.
entries.zh: 温迪把受潮的照片摊在一条干净毛巾上。

entries.en: Jeff found a parking space close to the theatre entrance.
entries.zh: 杰夫在剧院入口附近找到了一个停车位。

entries.en: The study offers a sociological explanation of changing household patterns.
entries.zh: 这项研究从社会学角度解释了家庭结构的变化。

entries.en: A demonstrator held up a handmade sign outside the council building.
entries.zh: 一名示威者在议会大楼外举着手制标语牌。

entries.en: The sociologist interviewed commuters about their daily travel routines.
entries.zh: 社会学家采访了通勤者，了解他们日常出行的情况。

entries.en: Bryan tied a bright ribbon to his suitcase handle.
entries.zh: 布赖恩在手提箱把手上系了一条鲜艳的丝带。

entries.meaningZh: 在环境方面；从环保角度
entries.en: The new packaging was environmentally preferable to the old plastic trays.
entries.zh: 从环保角度看，新包装优于旧式塑料托盘。

entries.en: Greg saved the damaged file under a different name.
entries.zh: 格雷格用另一个名称保存了损坏的文件。

entries.en: Jennifer checked the ingredient list before buying the biscuits.
entries.zh: 詹妮弗在买饼干前查看了配料表。

entries.en: Boris carried the telescope outside when the clouds finally cleared.
entries.zh: 云层终于散开后，鲍里斯把望远镜搬到了外面。

entries.en: Joanna numbered the pages before handing in her manuscript.
entries.zh: 乔安娜交手稿前给各页编了号。

entries.en: Pamela pressed the seam flat with a warm iron.
entries.zh: 帕梅拉用温热的熨斗把接缝熨平。

entries.en: Rex brought a folding stool to the outdoor sketching session.
entries.zh: 雷克斯参加户外写生活动时带了一把折叠凳。

entries.meaningZh: 莫莉（女子名；原主词条含歧视性旧释义，待另行校正）
entries.en: Molly asked the librarian to reserve the illustrated edition.
entries.zh: 莫莉请图书管理员预留那本插图版。

entries.en: Hannah measured the shelf before ordering a new storage box.
entries.zh: 汉娜订购新收纳盒前量了量架子。

entries.en: Ms Wilkinson checked the emergency exits before the audience arrived.
entries.zh: 观众到场前，威尔金森女士检查了紧急出口。

entries.en: Doug offered to repair the loose board on the footbridge.
entries.zh: 道格主动提出修好人行桥上那块松动的木板。

entries.en: The parcel of tea from Taiwan arrived this morning.
entries.zh: 从台湾寄来的那包茶叶今天早晨到了。

entries.en: Amy matched the fallen button to the cardigan on the chair.
entries.zh: 艾米认出掉落的纽扣来自椅子上的开衫。

entries.en: The climbers reached the col between the two snowy peaks.
entries.zh: 登山者到达了两座雪峰之间的山口。

entries.en: Elaine wiped the dust from the old camera lens.
entries.zh: 伊莱恩擦去了旧相机镜头上的灰尘。

entries.en: The interview transcription included pauses and unfinished sentences.
entries.zh: 访谈转写文本保留了停顿和未说完的句子。

entries.en: The library sent the borrower a reminder about the overdue book.
entries.zh: 图书馆给借书人发送了逾期图书提醒。

entries.en: Mr Crawford marked the uneven paving stones with chalk.
entries.zh: 克劳福德先生用粉笔标出了不平整的铺路石。

entries.en: The multicultural festival featured storytelling in several languages.
entries.zh: 多元文化节安排了用多种语言讲故事的活动。

entries.en: Wesley moved his desk away from the noisy corridor.
entries.zh: 韦斯利把书桌搬离了嘈杂的走廊。

entries.en: She kept the old BT telephone bill with her household records.
entries.zh: 她把那张旧英国电信电话账单与家庭文件保存在一起。

entries.en: Nicola tested the colour on a spare piece of fabric.
entries.zh: 妮古拉在一块多余布料上试了试颜色。

entries.en: Celia wrote the unfamiliar address on the back of a receipt.
entries.zh: 西莉亚把陌生地址写在一张收据背面。

entries.en: The final answer was inaudible because a bus passed nearby.
entries.zh: 附近驶过一辆公交车，最后的回答因此听不清。

entries.en: Carolyn took the muddy boots outside before cleaning them.
entries.zh: 卡罗琳先把沾泥的靴子拿到外面，再进行清洗。

entries.en: The guitarist tuned one string while the singer introduced the song.
entries.zh: 歌手介绍歌曲时，吉他手调了其中一根弦。

entries.en: I used a spreadsheet to compare the monthly electricity bills.
entries.zh: 我用电子表格比较了每月电费。

entries.en: The algorithm sorts the records by date before removing duplicates.
entries.zh: 算法先按日期排列记录，再去除重复项。

entries.en: The anatomy diagram showed the intestinal wall in cross section.
entries.zh: 解剖图展示了肠壁的横截面。

entries.meaningZh: 纹章学上位于持盾者右侧的
entries.en: In the heraldic drawing, a star occupies the dexter side.
entries.zh: 在这幅纹章图中，一颗星位于持盾者右侧。

entries.en: The captain intercepted the pass near midfield.
entries.zh: 队长在中场附近截下了传球。

entries.en: Travis checked the walking route for steep sections before inviting us.
entries.zh: 特拉维斯在邀请我们前，查看了步行路线中有哪些陡坡路段。

entries.en: The teacher underlined the infinitive in each example sentence.
entries.zh: 老师在每个例句中的动词不定式下面画了线。

entries.en: The textbook discusses ulcerative colitis in a separate chapter.
entries.zh: 教材用单独一章讨论溃疡性结肠炎。

entries.en: The medical student labelled the oesophageal muscles on the diagram.
entries.zh: 那名医学生在图上标出了食管肌肉。

entries.en: The research poster included a diagram of colonic tissue.
entries.zh: 研究海报中包含一幅结肠组织的示意图。

entries.meaningZh: 地方议员（councillor的缩写，见于部分英式新闻文体）
entries.en: Coun Patel asked whether the new footpath would remain open.
entries.zh: 帕特尔议员问，那条新的人行道是否会继续开放。

entries.en: The novel depicts a community resisting years of political oppression.
entries.zh: 小说描写了一个群体反抗多年政治压迫的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 婴儿潮一代的人（baby boomer的非正式简称）
entries.en: As a boomer, my neighbour remembers a very different school system.
entries.zh: 作为婴儿潮一代的人，我的邻居记得当年很不一样的学校制度。

entries.en: Our team narrowly won the final match by a single point.
entries.zh: 我们队仅以一分优势险胜了决赛。

entries.en: The hospital notes recorded when the bleeding had stopped.
entries.zh: 医院记录注明了出血停止的时间。

entries.en: The film became internationally known after several festival screenings.
entries.zh: 这部电影在几次影展放映后享誉国际。

entries.en: He asked for forgiveness after admitting that he had broken the vase.
entries.zh: 他承认自己打碎了花瓶，并请求原谅。

entries.en: The lecture considered the societal effects of longer working hours.
entries.zh: 讲座探讨了工作时间延长带来的社会层面影响。

entries.en: Rain streamed down the windshield faster than the wipers could clear it.
entries.zh: 雨水沿挡风玻璃流下，快得让雨刷来不及清除。

entries.en: The preschool organised a picnic for the children and their families.
entries.zh: 幼儿园为孩子和他们的家人组织了一次野餐。

entries.en: The emergency cupboard contained canned beans and bottled water.
entries.zh: 应急储物柜里放着罐装豆子和瓶装水。

entries.en: The sudden realisation that the keys were inside made her stop.
entries.zh: 她突然意识到钥匙在里面，便停住了脚步。

entries.en: She listened intensely, trying to catch every word through the noise.
entries.zh: 她全神贯注地听，努力在噪声中听清每一个字。

entries.en: A schoolboy pointed out the lost glove beside the bus stop.
entries.zh: 一名男学生指出了公交站旁那只遗失的手套。

entries.en: The negotiator asked both sides to explain their main concerns.
entries.zh: 谈判者请双方说明各自最主要的关切。
